ValidationRule.description: #21305 Once the opportunity is won the Opportunity Type can not be changed #20656- Added bypass logic to edit Type in late stage #24480 -Should trigger for only Standard record type not for CPQ Record Type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED( Type ), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '7 - Closed')), NOT( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(StageName), '4 - Negotiate') ),
$Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin',
NOT( $Permission.Edit_Type_in_Late_Stage_Opp ), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName='Standard_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName='IMLA_Standard_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName='IME_Standard_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName='IMAP_Standard_Opportunity' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update the Opportunity Type once an Opportunity has been Won. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
